subject: literacy
concept: Decoding words containing initial consonant blends
source_inspiration: adapted from Mississippi Science-of-Reading explicit phonics sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student sounds out blend words letter by letter, then blends the whole word together
exercise.pictorial: Student matches decoded blend words to their matching picture
exercise.abstract: Student reads blend words aloud without picture support

misconception_flags: drops one sound of the blend when decoding (e.g. reads 'st' as just 's')

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
